meta.description: Compare 13 AI chains for spoken Kikuyu by answer quality and response time.
meta.og_description: Results for 13 AI chains tested on 24 spoken Kikuyu questions.

hero.lead_html: The best of 13 AI chains scores 86 out of 100 on spoken Kikuyu questions. The strongest results pair a language model with Kikuyu Whisper v2, showing how language-specific speech recognition can improve answers for Gĩkũyũ speakers in Kenya.

voice.sub:
Which mountain is the
highest in Kenya?

board.hint: The dashed line is the 10 s limit for phone calls. Sovereign-deployable chains are highlighted in blue.
board.note: Sovereign-deployable means every model step can be run in your country or on your own servers. The four Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 chains use open-weight language models with self-hostable speech recognition. This describes a deployment option, not the location used for these benchmark runs.

scatter.aria: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Kikuyu Whisper v2 has the highest score.

score.front: Labelled: the best chain and the best sovereign-deployable one
score.note: Hover a point for a quick look, select it for details. Source: Gooey.AI, Aug 30, 2026.

cost.front: GPT-5.6 Sol averaged $40.42; all other chains averaged $40.00
cost.note: Arithmetic mean of 24 observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charges per chain, normalized to 1,000 questions. Historical benchmark pricing, not a future-price guarantee. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

carbon.front: Labelled best trade-offs among covered chains
carbon.note: EcoCost estimate from 24 runs per covered chain; low confidence. Speech recognition and direct-audio inference are excluded. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

chains_foot_p:
Answer score: semantic match with a reference answer, 0 to 100, over 24 questions. Response: median seconds.
Sovereign-deployable means the model chain can run on infrastructure you control; it does not identify where the benchmark itself ran.
samples_intro: Three of the 24 questions, spoken in Kikuyu. Answers are from Gemini 3.1 Pro with Kikuyu Whisper v2, the highest-scoring chain, and are graded against a reference answer.
